purpose: Teach: 腹筋/退治/金髪/トウモロコシ/ねずみ/かぼちゃ/ウイスキー/サウナ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、腹筋いつもやってんな
lines.en: Riku — you've got those abs going pretty much every day, huh?
lines.style: Playful tease with genuine curiosity underneath. Light, quick delivery. Trying to get a rise out of him but actually interested in the answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゴキブリ退治得意だろ、桜
lines.en: You're the one who's good at dealing with cockroaches, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting with a half-smile. Quiet counterattack — turning it back on her before she can push further. Unfazed exterior, amused at getting caught out.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、金髪に憧れてるんだろ?
lines.en: So Riku — you've got a thing for blond hair, don't you?
lines.style: Pressing now, voice a little lighter, testing the waters. Not malicious — more like a friend poking to see what he'll admit. Quick rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食のトウモロコシ残すなよ、桜
lines.en: You're not going to waste the corn from lunch today, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat, almost bored delivery. But it's not actually bored — it's affectionate concern dressed up as indifference. A rule he's setting down without making it a thing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ねずみのキャラ好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you like those mouse characters, don't you?
lines.style: Lifting slightly at the end, inviting him to admit it. Genuinely curious, no edge to it. Testing whether he trusts her enough to be honest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ハロウィンでかぼちゃ被ったろ?桜
lines.en: You wore a pumpkin head to Halloween, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet call-out with a micro-pause before her name. Small laugh underneath it. Using her own observation game back against her — it's fair game now.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ウイスキーは大人になってからだぞ
lines.en: Riku — you've got to wait until you're an adult for whisky, okay?
lines.style: Tone shifts to genuinely serious. Lowered volume, steadier rhythm. The teasing stops here — this is actual concern disguised as a rule. Almost maternal.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サウナ熱すぎだろ、桜
lines.en: The sauna's way too hot for you, Sakura.
lines.style: Final word slightly clipped. Tired patience — he's said this before and will say it again. Resigned affection, the way someone warns a friend about their own bad habits.
